title: Corrected rail lens domain

provenance.limitations: Whole domain runtime modules are transpiled without TypeScript types. The rail-filters control is adapted to remove opposite-polarity terms and incompatible read/running statuses of the requested lens. The review boundary omits UI wiring and captured historical instructions.

audit: Changed rail domain behavior covers typed and complete status lenses, quoted and negated terms, opposite-polarity words, read/unread and running/input conflicts, combined terms, partial lenses, and ambiguous stored lenses. Browser state and UI wiring are outside this domain boundary.
